name: Dry dog food
definition: complete dry kibble food made for dogs.

name: Wet dog food
definition: complete canned or pouched moist food made for dogs.

name: Fresh or frozen dog food
definition: chilled or frozen prepared or raw food made for dogs.

name: Freeze-dried or air-dried dog food
definition: dehydrated raw or cooked food made for dogs.

name: Veterinary diet (dog)
definition: food formulated for a dog's health need and sold as a diet beside dry and wet.

name: Dog treat
definition: a reward or snack for dogs that is not a complete food.

name: Dog crate
definition: a box or cage in which a dog is kept or transported at home.

name: Dog kennel
definition: an outdoor house for a dog.

name: Dog bed
definition: a bed, cushion or basket made for a dog to sleep on.

name: Dog collar
definition: a band worn round a dog's neck.

name: Dog lead
definition: a line used to hold or walk a dog.

name: Dog harness
definition: straps worn round a dog's body to hold or walk it.

name: Dog coat
definition: a garment made to be worn by a dog.

name: Dog toy
definition: an object made for a dog to chew, fetch, tug or play with.

name: Dog agility equipment
definition: obstacles and gear for dog sport and training.

name: Dry cat food
definition: complete dry kibble food made for cats.

name: Cat tree
definition: a free-standing or pole-fixed climbing and resting structure made for cats.

name: Cat litter
definition: absorbent material made for a cat's toilet.

name: Small-animal food
definition: food made for rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and other small mammals.

name: Small-animal cage or hutch
definition: a cage, habitat or hutch in which a small mammal is housed.

name: English saddle
definition: a saddle of the English riding tradition.

name: Western saddle
definition: a saddle of the Western riding tradition.

name: Saddle pad or numnah
definition: a pad worn under a saddle.

name: Bridle
definition: headgear with reins by which a horse is steered.

name: Snaffle bit
definition: a direct-pressure bit.

name: Curb bit
definition: a leverage bit.

name: Bitless bridle (hackamore)
definition: headgear that steers without a mouthpiece.

name: Headcollar or halter
definition: headgear used to lead or tie a horse.

name: Turnout rug
definition: a waterproof rug (blanket) worn by a horse outdoors.

name: Stable rug
definition: a rug (blanket) worn by a horse indoors.

name: Fly mask
definition: a mesh mask worn over a horse's face against flies.

name: Tendon boot
definition: a protective boot worn on a horse's leg.

name: Horse grooming brush
definition: a brush made for grooming a horse.

name: Fish food
definition: food made for aquarium or pond fish.

name: Aquarium (tank)
definition: a glass or acrylic tank in which fish are kept.
